quests.title: Mark both ends
quests.ask: In a three-cell corridor, put one gem on the first cell and one on the last, and leave the middle empty.
quests.nudge: Which gem can go down before the walk, and which only after it?

quests.title: When both ends meet
quests.ask: In a one-cell corridor the first cell is also the last. It should end with exactly one gem.
quests.nudge: When the robot reaches the end, how can it tell the cell is already marked?
